name: Camera brackets (set of 4)
note: One USB camera behind each side window, so she always knows which side you are on and the view on that side is rendered from exactly where you stand.
print: Print flat, all four at once.

name: Light bar diffusers (set of 4)
note: A glowing strip across each side of the pedestal.
print: Print flat, two per plate.

name: Screen clips (set of 4)
note: Hold the screen down on its ledge.
print: Print flat, all four at once.

name: Electronics trays (pair)
note: Mounts the ESP32, amplifier, USB hub and power board in the back of the pedestal.
print: Print flat.

name: LG DualUp 28" monitor, face down (481.5 x 549.5 x 45 mm)
note: A near-square 2560 x 2880 screen. Its middle 466 mm square shows four views of her, one beside each glass face.

name: Four beam-splitter glass panels
note: Teleprompter glass triangles (about 460 mm base, 310 mm slant, tip cut off) at 45 degrees. Each one shows her from its own side.

name: 4 inch speaker (down-firing) + amplifier
note: Fires down inside the pedestal and comes out of all four grilles.

name: USB camera boards (x4)
note: Small 1080p cameras, one per side.

name: Where she appears (about 20 cm, seen from all four sides)
note: A stand-in shape at the centre of the pyramid. Her real model never goes into these files.
